notes: Sources: 2018_02 is the Faculty Handbook (revised August 2016), the governing document for faculty ('The rights, privileges, and responsibilities of the faculty of Ohio University are governed by ... the latest revision of this Faculty Handbook'); it holds the Sick Leave Policy (II.H), Leaves of Absence (II.I) with FMLA (II.I.3), Parental Leave (II.J), tenure-clock extensions (II.D.2.e, II.H.6, II.I.2.e.iii), part-time appointments (II.C.3) and Disability Insurance (III.J). 2018_00 is the HR page of the Pilot Parental Leave Program (capture 2016-04); 2018_01 is the HR leaves-of-absence summary (capture 2017-07). Every component carries version_uncertain (per each document's version note: a 2017 handbook edition probably governed on 2018-02-25; the pilot's status on that date is not shown).
Governing document: the handbook covers tenure-stream (Group I) faculty and sets faculty parental leave, so missing is false (the no-policy coding (`missing`) not triggered).

Pilot Parental Leave Program (c1): its page says the pilot ran 2013-2014, was extended to 2015-12-31 and then to 2016-06-30, after which 'a determination will be made about the future of the program'. No saved source shows whether it was in force on 2018-02-25; 2018_01 (2017-07) still lists it, with its older 2013-2014 term text. Coded as written with version_uncertain and an ambiguous flag; the sources leave unresolved whether to count it.

Chain, birth parent: FMLA 12 workweeks (c3), with the Pilot Program's 12 weeks (first 6 paid) concurrent with it (c1, if in force) -> Faculty Handbook parental leave up to 3 months consecutive_after FMLA (c2). Summary-only path, not counted: medical leave concurrent with FMLA, six months in all (c7) -> disability leave (c8, no length).

Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA 12 workweeks (c3), with the Pilot Program's 12 weeks (first 6 paid) concurrent with it (c1, if in force) -> Faculty Handbook parental leave up to 3 months consecutive_after FMLA (c2).

Sick leave (c4) is an accrued balance (15 days a year, unlimited accrual) with no fixed length; the Pilot Program lets it cover the program's six unpaid weeks. It is left unlinked (a balance of unknown length adds no weeks). The handbook says 'FMLA leave time is not accrued during sick leave, holiday, or vacation time' (II.I.3); its meaning (eligibility hours or the running of FMLA leave) is not clear and no link is coded from it.

No modified duties, teaching relief, top-up, donated leave or government benefit appears in the saved sources. Ohio has no state paid leave programme named in the documents, and the statutory baseline has no Ohio rows.

Cited but not saved: Policy and Procedures Manual No. 40.054 (Family and Medical Leave); No. 40.029 (Sick Leave Policy); No. 41.105 (retirement contribution during leave); Policy #41.128 (Leaves of Absence for Presidential Appointees); #40.033 (Leaves of Absence for Classified Employees); #40.027 (Personal Leave for Administrative Employees); #41.127 (Military Leave for Classified Employees); HR Guidelines and Guideline Summary for FMLA; Pilot Parental Leave Program directions, FAQ and replacement-cost application; HR disability benefits page; the university disability insurance policy; the Benefits Program Handbook; the 2017 Faculty Handbook edition (per the version note). Also cited but not relevant to leave: Policy 03.004, 03.006, 41.135, 19.048, 19.052, 17.001, 15.006, 15.007, 12.020, 40.016, 41.121, 93.002.

Calendar: semester system; IV.I.3 gives 'the full fourteen weeks of instruction' per semester, recorded as term_weeks 14 (no component is stated in semesters except the general-purpose leave of absence, coded in years).

Not components: University Faculty Fellowship (sabbatical) leave, Distinguished Professor leave, research leaves and teaching-load reductions for research (V.A, V.C, V.D), political-activity leave (I.B), military leave (II.I.2.i), educational leave (2018_01): none can be used for a birth or adoption. Early retirement part-time teaching (III.R) is for retirement-eligible faculty only.

HR-page medical leave (c7), disability leave (c8): the page does not name the groups covered and points to policies for presidential appointees and classified employees; the faculty handbook (governing for faculty) has no such leaves, so they are coded summary_only with the group question flagged ambiguous. Personal leave (c10) is coded for administrative employees, as its linked policy (#40.027) names them.
